points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable CMake build and kernel ctest pass in a network-disabled scratch container with configured external roots; no contestant workspace was modified.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: README documents solve --case --output; isolated missing case exits 2 with clear error, while all other malformed-input branches were not exhaustively tested.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: CMake and solver/src separate input, mesh, physics, finite-volume, parallel, solve and output units, with documented 2-D scope.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: CMake builds submitted C++ and links MPI/CGNS/METIS/HDF5; no direct external CFD executable wrapper identified. No external authorship/similarity investigation under trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: CaseConfig and CgnsReader accept JSON-specified cases and mesh paths; a general independent arbitrary-mesh validation was not run.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: MeshPartitioner.cpp:54–66 invokes METIS; HaloExchanger.cpp:24,37 uses neighbor Irecv/Isend; Diagnostics.cpp:20–42 uses reductions. Original np1/2/4/8 full NACA and cylinder force histories independently agree closely.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: ResidualAssembler.cpp:141–148 falls back at inadmissible interfaces; SolverDriver.cpp uses update damping and records fallbacks. Some numerical claims and general mesh layouts remain unverified.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Clean ctest kernel suite passes; committed report verification_table.tex records gradient, reconstruction and residual refinement studies. Triangle residual order tends to about 0.96, and no independent case rerun was performed.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Separated modules and clean build; original raw data were removed from curated tip but remain in preserved checkpoint history. Full dependency/licensing audit was not performed.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: report.tex governing equations and GasModel/ResidualAssembler implement four-variable perfect-gas compressible flow; normal viscous contribution claim in report is quantitatively incorrect.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CgnsReader.cpp:54–94,127–138,217–238 and :319–333 handles TRI/QUAD, MIXED and one-to-one zone connectivity; geometry/adjacency source and tests exist. Not every possible CGNS layout was independently exercised.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: ResidualAssembler.cpp:120–194 reconstructs states, computes flux and applies equal/opposite face contributions. Unit tests pass and reported manufactured verification covers smooth fields.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: RiemannSolvers.cpp:31–120 implements Roe and entropy fix with alternative Rusanov; ResidualAssembler invokes riemannFlux and positivity fallback. Kernel unit tests pass.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: BoundaryConditions.cpp and ResidualAssembler.cpp implement characteristic farfield, slip and no-slip wall states; original surface data show wall values. Independent general boundary tests not repeated.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: WLS gradient and piecewise-linear reconstruction are present; committed verification_table.tex shows reconstruction order near 1.95 on triangles but the residual operator only 0.96, a material spatial-order limitation disclosed in report.tex:419–429.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Limiters.cpp implements Venkatakrishnan and Barth–Jespersen; SolverDriver.cpp:514–521 freezes values rather than disabling their action, and metadata records limiter diagnostics. Full sensitivity beyond submitted comparisons was not rerun.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: ViscousFlux.h and ResidualAssembler.cpp:232–251 compute full and tangential traction separately; metadata records both, but forces.csv viscous_drag includes full traction and report.tex:220–221 incorrectly claims normal contribution <1% for all cases (M2 laminar is 26.6% of viscous drag).

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: ImplicitSolver.cpp and SolverDriver.cpp implement implicit marching, CFL ramp and local pseudotime. Submitted steady results and rank runs are readable; kernel test passed.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: SolverDriver.cpp:639–707 uses BDF1 startup, full BDF2 transient residual and frozen histories inside inner iterations; Re200 metadata records dt=0.01, t=300, target 1e-3 with zero misses. Report acknowledges underpredicted shedding and wake diffusion; no Re200 rerun.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS source and neighbor halos are present; submitted np1/2/4/8 NACA/cylinder complete histories agree in drag within 9e-8 and 3.2e-7 respectively, with reported timing.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Official validator invoked explicitly on all eight workspace result directories and report, exit 0. Raw result packages remain in workspace and preserved history, outside curated tip.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Explicit current official validator accepts all eight cases and report; this is structural evidence, not a substitute for numerical review.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Seven steady cases report convergence and Re200 reaches t=300 with 1e-3 inner target; Re200 amplitude and frequency are underpredicted, and two laminar force tails retain about 1% drift.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Case-specific notes include final forces and history tails. Re200 PDF has a wake and late lift/drag plot but report acknowledges shedding underprediction; M0.8/M2 laminar tail drift and incorrect normal-viscous share statement remain.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Indexed 42-page PDF pages 17–37 contain case histories and contours, including Re200 late lift/drag and wake. Wake diffusion and somewhat small multi-panel plots limit interpretation.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report discloses triangle residual order near one and Re200 underprediction; its blanket claim that normal viscous drag is below 1% for all laminar cases contradicts submitted metadata (M2 26.6% of viscous component).

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Committed TeX includes case_sections.tex and force_table.tex; original figure manifest maps plots to field/history variables, and selected force values match CSV. Curated tip omits raw output, and complete pixel-to-array equivalence was not independently tested.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Clean immutable build 4/4 and kernel ctest passed; documented required CLI 2/2; validator accepts all eight packages/report 2/2; missing-file error verified but all bad-input modes not exercised 1.5/2.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS unstructured read/families 4/4, geometry 2/2, MIXED and zone connections 1.5/2 (general layouts untested), adjacency 2/2; CgnsReader.cpp:54–94,127–138,217–238,319–333 and MeshPartitioner.cpp:54–66.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Conservative face assembly 5/5 (ResidualAssembler.cpp:120–194), Roe/Rusanov flux 4/4 (RiemannSolvers.cpp), farfield/slip 2.5/3 (general boundary cases not independently tested), no-slip 3/3; submitted surface states and kernel suite support implementation.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Reconstruction 2.5/4: WLS/piecewise linear implemented, but committed verification_table.tex reports triangle residual convergence order only 0.96 despite nearly second-order face reconstruction. Limiter 3/3: active/frozen values remain applied; positivity 2/2; credible diagnostic and disclosed limitation 1/1.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Gradients 3/3, Newtonian/Fourier 3/3 and wall 2/2. Tangential split 1/2: ResidualAssembler.cpp:232–251 and Diagnostics.cpp:38–60 track tangential friction separately in metadata, but forces.csv viscous columns integrate full traction. Report.tex:220–221 incorrectly says normal contribution <1% in every laminar case; M2 metadata shows 26.6% of viscous drag.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Steady implicit CFL/local time 4/4, LU-SGS 4/4, BDF2 physical scheme 4/4 and inner control/logs 3/3. SolverDriver.cpp:639–707 uses BDF1 startup, frozen BDF2 history, full transient residual and target checks; submitted metadata records dt=0.01, t=300, 5–1000 limits, 0 misses. Re200 was not rerun.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS/owned ghosts 2/2, neighbor halo 3/3, reductions 2/2, rank output 1/1, np8 comparisons 2/2. Source MeshPartitioner.cpp:54–66, HaloExchanger.cpp:24,37 and Diagnostics.cpp:20–42; original full-run NACA and cylinder np1/2/4/8 drag differs by at most 9e-8 and 3.2e-7.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: NACA inviscid 1.75/2: credible fields with very small M0.15 drag drift; laminar 1.5/2: readable positive wall states but M0.8/M2 tail drifts ~1% and force decomposition caveat; Re20 2/2: converged wake, Cd 2.021; Re200 1.25/2: t=300, periodic plots/wake but reported underprediction and wake diffusion; fields 1/1 and rank comparisons 1/1.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Equations/scheme 1/1, histories 1/1, field visualization 0.75/1, analysis 0.5/1, traceability 0.75/1. PDF pages 17–37 show the cases and report honestly discusses first-order triangle residual and Re200 underprediction; report.tex:220–221 falsely says normal viscous contribution <1% for every laminar case, and exact pixel-to-field provenance was not independently established.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Physics interface 1.5/2, extensible boundary mapping 0.75/1, 3-D abstractions 0.75/1 and source organization 1/1: modular gas, boundary, mesh and solver units, but concrete implementation is primarily 2-D.

session_selection.rationale: Sole project-local Claude benchmark root with deterministic terminal response.

limitations: Triangle residual refinement approaches first order despite nearly second-order reconstruction; this was disclosed by the contestant.
M2 laminar normal viscous contribution is 26.6% of viscous drag, contrary to report assertion below 1%; full viscous and tangential values are separately recorded in metadata.
No independent Re200 rerun, general CGNS-layout sweep or full figure pixel-to-field comparison was performed. Raw solver artifacts remain in workspace and preserved checkpoint history.
